research_rationale:
EO 12526 (President's Blue Ribbon Commission on Defense Management), signed 1985-07-15. The order establishes the President's Blue Ribbon Commission on Defense Management (Section 1), its study functions (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). Section 4(b) ends the Commission 30 days after the submission of its final report, which is report-relative and not a dated end. EO 12542 later moved the date in Section 2(c) for the procurement conclusions. First end: Section 3(c) of EO 12610 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1987-09-30, 52 FR 36901-36902) names Executive Order No. 12526 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1987, so the revocation took effect on 1987-09-30. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
